title: UFOs appear at the time of the Manhattan Project

tellings.quote: you have to wonder at that time because that's when all the UFOs pop up.

plain: Michels suggests that UFO sightings began to surge in the 1940s, just as the Manhattan Project, the secret wartime US effort to build the atomic bomb, was under way. He raises this himself while talking about the physicists J. Robert Oppenheimer and Teller and the film Oppenheimer, saying "you have to wonder at that time because that's when all the UFOs pop up." The suggestion is that something may have been watching humanity's arrival at nuclear weapons.
